classified_as.description: A tool that helps sales teams track leads and customers, manage calls, emails, and texts, and automate follow-ups so deals move forward.
classified_as.name: Sales CRM Software

match_decision.reason: Sales CRM Software helps sales teams manage leads and customer communication. Web Script and Tracker Compliance Monitoring scans websites for privacy and security compliance. These are different products for different needs, so a buyer would not compare them as alternatives.

classified_as.description: A tool that scans websites to find third party scripts, trackers, and cookies, then monitors and blocks unauthorized data transfers so companies can meet privacy and payment security rules.
classified_as.name: Web Script and Tracker Compliance Monitoring

match_decision.reason: No existing categories to compare against yet.

classified_as.description: A cloud based tool that helps small business owners and freelancers track income and expenses, send invoices, accept payments, and manage their day to day finances.
classified_as.name: Small Business Accounting Software

match_decision.reason: None of the existing categories cover accounting or finance tools. Product management, sales CRM, and web compliance monitoring are all different types of software. A small business owner shopping for accounting software would not compare it against any of these.

classified_as.description: A tool that helps software teams plan, track, and ship product work by organizing tasks, roadmaps, and feedback in one place.
classified_as.name: Product Management Software

match_decision.reason: Product management software helps teams plan and ship product work. Sales CRM software helps sales teams track leads and close deals. These are different products for different teams and needs, so a buyer would not compare them as alternatives.

classified_as.description: A tool that lets sales and marketing teams record, send, host, and track personalized videos, then measure how viewers engage with them and connect that activity to leads and revenue.
classified_as.name: Sales Video Engagement Platform

match_decision.reason: This tool makes and tracks sales videos. None of the existing categories do that. Sales CRM Software is related because it also helps sales teams, but it manages leads and messages rather than video creation and viewing.
